what: The title is split into word chunks. When the element enters the screen, each word stands up over .937s from tilted back 45° (rotateX −45°, perspective 600), 50% of its height lower and transparent. It starts .3s later, each word .05s after the previous, curve cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1). Once only. With on: load it runs right on attach

options.dur: Duration of a single word (s), default .937
options.delay: Start delay (seconds), default .3 — if emphasized words are wrapped separately and chained, adds the number of preceding words × each
options.rise: Distance to lower it (word height %), default 50
options.ease: Curve, default 0.19,1,0.22,1 — a GSAP name also works
options.on: If 「load」, it starts right away without waiting to be visible
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top bottom (1px entering)

from.where: index.html .av-panel__title · about.html .av-pagehead__title: panel title and subpage header title
